SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  AVG(COALESCE(NULLIF(basket_totals.total_per_receipt, 0), 0)) as avg_basket_value
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT receipt_id, SUM(net_amount) as total_per_receipt
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY receipt_id
) basket_totals ON f.receipt_id = basket_totals.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.store_key, SUM(f.net_amount) as receipt_total
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key
)
SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  ROUND(AVG(ps.receipt_total), 2) as avg_basket_value
FROM period_sales ps
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON ps.store_key = s.store_key
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as unique_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
AND s.format = 'Large'

SELECT 
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as avg_per_receipt
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
AND s.format = 'Large'

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.store_key, SUM(f.gross_amount) as receipt_total
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key
)
SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  ROUND(AVG(ps.receipt_total), 2) as avg_basket_value
FROM period_sales ps
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON ps.store_key = s.store_key
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

-- Verify the period dates and check for any other issues
SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) as period_start,
  MAX(sale_date) as period_end,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as total_receipts,
  COUNT(*) as total_lines
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'

-- Check if there are any NULL net_amount values that might affect the average
SELECT COUNT(*) as null_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE net_amount IS NULL
AND sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'

-- Check for negative amounts (possible returns recorded in sales table)
SELECT COUNT(*) as negative_count, MIN(net_amount) as min_amount
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE net_amount < 0
AND sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND sale_date <= '2026-08-30'

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.store_key, SUM(f.net_amount) as receipt_total
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-08-03' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id, f.store_key
)
SELECT 
  s.format,
  ROUND(AVG(ps.receipt_total), 2) as avg_basket_value
FROM period_sales ps
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON ps.store_key = s.store_key
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format
